label: PF Backlog 580
title: RCCA: dev checks scratch `git init` could resolve to the PARENT repo and wipe a worktree (stray init commit; core.bare flip)
body:
5-Why: a worktree got wiped (stray `commit: init`; `core.bare` flipped) -> a scratch git op ran against the worktree repo -> the scratch dir had no own `.git` at that moment / a leaked GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE let git walk UP to the parent -> scratch git ops used `subprocess.run(["git",...], cwd=scratch)` with no env sanitization and no ceiling -> PF dev checks/tests (`validation_engine_check`, `feature_pr_check`, `e2e_lifecycle`, `github_check`, `worker_check`, `repo_setup_check`, `dogfood_check`, `vcs_worktree_check`, `core/vcs.py`) create scratch repos but did not guarantee isolation.

Fix (PR #116): `scripts/dev/scratch_repo.py` isolates scratch repos - keep under `products/_test_*`, sanitize GIT_* env, pin GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES, verify toplevel==scratch (fail closed); patched `validation_engine_check` + `core/e2e_lifecycle`; regression test `test_scratch_repo_isolation.py`. Guard: the same helper should be adopted by the remaining scratch-git checks.

objective: Prevent dev scratch git ops from resolving to the parent repo (never wipe a worktree).
acceptance_criteria: A scratch git op can never run against the parent repo (env sanitized + ceiling + toplevel guard).
Scratch repos live under products/_test_* with their own .git (verified).
A regression test proves isolation even with a leaked GIT_DIR.
